== Summary ==
Team Albany - a Sokol, the Terwilligers and some other guy mug large for the digicam. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Team Albany]].

Left to right:
# [[Matt Sokol]], beige cap ([[:File:Matt Sokol DecipherCon 1999.jpg]])
# [[Brian Terwilliger]], white cap and glasses ([[:File:Brian Terwilliger DecipherCon 1999.jpg]])
# [[Dan Sokol]], yellow Team Albany shirt without cap, third from left (the rightmost of the four in yellow shirts) ([[:File:Dan Sokol DecipherCon 1999.jpg]])
# [[Chris Terwilliger]], kneeling in front, glasses ([[:File:Chris Terwilliger DecipherCon 1999.jpg]])
# [[Jonny Chu]], white shirt ([[:File:Jonny Chu DecipherCon 1999.jpg]])

Identification: Bill Bisco (personal communication, 25 October 2026) identified players 1, 2, 4 and 5. Chu is the one player not in a yellow shirt. Faces of Brian, Chris and Chu match [[:File:Team Albany 2000 Team Championship.jpg]]. [[Matt Sokol]] identified the man in the yellow Team Albany shirt, third from left (player 3), as his brother [[Dan Sokol]] and the man in the white T-shirt (player 5) as [[Jonny Chu]] (personal communication to Bill Bisco, 27 October 2026).
